title: Mapped horizontal-cut total is the shifted-cycle subcomplex
statement: Let I be a first-quadrant bicomplex in a Grothendieck abelian category B (integer horizontal degree, nonnegative vertical degree, zero negative horizontal columns). Let G:B->C be additive and left exact. Extend vertically by zero using mappedFunctor [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Let L have degreewise steps equal to the second filtration of Tot(GI) [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let u be the mapped-total comparison, with the specified diagonal component equations. For q>=0, applying G to the flipped total of the horizontal good cut tau<=q I gives a complex isomorphic to Dec(L)^(-q) [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage], and its inclusion into the full total commutes with u inverse followed by totalFlipIso.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homology
source.place: Tag 015X, second filtration, finite-diagonal kernel calculation

proof.text: Extension by zero preserves finite limits: after evaluation in a nonnegative degree it is isomorphic to the original evaluation, and in a negative degree it is the zero functor. Consequently the mapTruncLEComparison for G followed by extension is an isomorphism commuting with truncation inclusions. Totalizing gives the mapped cut comparison.

Check naturality of the mapped-total comparison on every diagonal summand using its specified component equations and extendMap_f. Negative vertical degrees have zero source. Check naturality of totalFlipIso on the same summands, including its invertible signs. Apply the pure total-truncation/decalage comparison to the mapped first-quadrant bicomplex and compose the isomorphisms. The preceding inclusion equations give the required square.

theorem cartanEilenberg_good_cut_decalage
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vB} B]
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vC} C]
    (G : B ⥤ C) [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G]
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ B (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (hzero : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (I.X p))
    (q : ℤ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (L : DecreasingFiltration
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).obj I).total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hL : ∀ p m : ℤ, L.complexStep p m =
      ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).obj I).secondFiltration m).step p))
    (u : (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ≅
      (G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 B)).obj I).flip).total
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hu : ∀ (r : ℕ) (p n : ℤ) (h : (r : ℤ) + p = n),
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).obj I).flip).ιTotal
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (r : ℤ) p n h ≫ u.hom.f n =
        (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
          ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X p))
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := r) (i' := (r : ℤ)) rfl).hom ≫
        G.map ((HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
            (((𝟭 B).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X p))
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := r) (i' := (r : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
          (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 B)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (r : ℤ) p n h)) :
    let _J := (CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 B)).obj I
    let Jq := (CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 B)).obj
      (CochainComplex.truncLE I q)
    let M := (CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).obj I
    let i := HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
      ((HomologicalComplex₂.flipFunctor B (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
        ((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 B)).map
          (CochainComplex.ιTruncLE I q))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let c := u.symm ≪≫ M.totalFlipIso (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ d : (G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (Jq.flip.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ≅ L.decalageComplex (-q),
      (G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map i ≫ c.hom =
        d.hom ≫ L.decalageι (-q)
